build.name: OpenRC FPV5 experimental candidate x1: F50 2150 KV, F5146 5.1 in, 6S 1300 mAh, OpenRacer 205.3 mm square-X frame geometry

references.f50_table: LiG Power F50 2150 KV / F5146 static table, https://www.ligpower.com/product/f50-5inch-racing-drone-motor.html, accessed 2026-11-11 as transcribed in FPV/03 section 6; page bytes and hash not yet captured (intake open)
references.f5146_spec: T-Motor F5146 specification, https://www.t-hobby.com/products/t-motor-f5146-drone-propeller, accessed 2026-11-11 as transcribed in FPV/03 section 6: 5.1 in nominal diameter, 4.6 in pitch, recommends motors below 2100 KV (conflicts with the 2150 KV pairing; unresolved)

motor_rows.note: F50 2150 KV with F5146 static table (FPV/03 section 6); vendor-reported, no independent instrumentation or uncertainty

torque_display_half_step.note: displayed torque has two decimals; half a display step is taken as its uncertainty

no_load_current.note: typical for this motor class at 10 V; no datasheet row pinned

prop_diameter.note: T-Motor F5146 nominal 5.1 in = 129.54 mm (FPV/03 section 6), not a 5.0 in / 127 mm prop

rotor_inertia.note: prop plus bell about the spin axis from the lab fixture Plant.research_quad() (DR-01 derived check)

rotor_drag.note: rotor in-plane drag coefficient k_h from the lab fixture Plant.research_quad()

airframe_drag_areas.note: airframe drag areas from the lab fixture Plant.research_quad()

motor_diagonal.note: motor-to-motor diagonal measured from the pinned OpenRacer CAD (research/drone-racing/DR-29/receipt.json): true square X, 205.32 mm; a drawing dimension, not a measured airframe

motor_mass.note: typical 2306-class motor mass, one per hub

motor_centroid_below_hub.note: motor mass centroid below the prop hub plane, at the hub x/y; point mass (own inertia neglected so the bell is not counted twice with the rotor inertia)

prop_mass.note: typical 5.1-inch tri-blade prop mass, one per hub at the hub plane

mass_items.note: typical 5-inch carbon frame with top plate; centroid 12 mm below the hub plane; box inertia-equivalent to two 0.2053 m diagonal arms (side = diagonal/sqrt(2))
stack/ESC/receiver/VTX/camera/wiring lumped near the centre between the plates
typical 6S 1300 mAh LiPo strapped on top of the centre, 75 x 35 x 38 mm

capacity.note: 1300 mAh pack chosen for this candidate

cell_ocv.note: generic single-cell LiPo rest curve (soc, volts), not identified for a product

braking.note: complementary (damped) bridge switching, the usual default of current FPV ESC firmware: signed motor current, active braking and regeneration into the pack; no ESC was measured and no current limit is modelled

idle_command.note: idle command from the lab fixture / firmware default idle

max_command.note: maximum command from the lab fixture output limit

sample_rate.note: the only admitted controller sample schedule (240 Hz outer tick)

kp.note: rate-loop gain chosen by the DR-21 software step-response sweep on this estimated plant (docs/research/drone-racing/M1-M3-2026-11-11); not measured on hardware

ki.note: integral gain chosen by the DR-21 software step-response sweep on this estimated plant; not measured on hardware

kd.note: derivative-on-measurement gain chosen by the DR-21 software step-response sweep on this estimated plant; not measured on hardware

i_max.note: starting integral limit, to be requalified by the controller owner

kaw.note: starting back-calculation anti-windup gain, to be requalified by the controller owner

tau_limit.note: starting torque-request limit, to be requalified by the controller owner

gyro_lpf.note: first-order gyro low-pass cutoff below the 120 Hz Nyquist frequency

dterm_lpf.note: first-order D-term low-pass cutoff below the 120 Hz Nyquist frequency

kff.note: setpoint-acceleration feed-forward on roll and pitch: about 1.0 times the estimated axis inertia, chosen by the DR-21 software step-response sweep; none on yaw, where it saturates the small yaw torque limit and failed the 240 Hz sample-rate screen; not measured on hardware

setpoint_lpf.note: first-order setpoint low-pass ahead of the feed-forward derivative, below the 120 Hz Nyquist frequency

angle_max_tilt.note: Angle mode maximum tilt starting value

angle_gain.note: Angle mode attitude-to-rate gain starting value

angle_rate_limit.note: Angle mode roll/pitch rate cap starting value

allocator_weights.note: allocator row weights (collective, roll, pitch, yaw) starting value

throttle_rate.note: rate-throttle policy full-stick slew starting value

foot_depth.note: feet under the motors at the hub x/y, 22 mm below the hub plane

static_sag.note: static sag on four feet used to choose the total vertical stiffness; stiff enough that a firm landing does not sink the frame, integrated with four contact substeps near the ground

heave_damping_ratio.note: damping ratio of the heave mode used to choose the damping

prop_hull_height.note: crash hull points at the prop-disc centres, 12 mm above the hub plane

crash_speed.note: hull closing speed treated as a crash

rotor_strike_speed.note: rotor speed above which a prop strike counts

forward_of_cg.note: canopy camera pivot ahead of the frame centre in the pinned OpenRacer CAD (DR-29 receipt); a pivot position, not a lens calibration

above_hub_plane.note: canopy camera pivot 31.5 mm above the arm-top plane (DR-29 receipt) less an estimated 20 mm motor height between the arm top and the prop plane; not a calibration

tilt.note: camera uptilt starting point, not a calibration

hfov.note: horizontal field of view starting point, not a calibration
